# GitHub Copilot Instructions for Ray Vault Sync

## Strict Git & Contributor Rules
- **NEVER** add `Co-authored-by: Copilot` or any other bot/agent attribution or trailers to git commit messages or pull requests.
- **NEVER** act or register as a repository contributor.
- Do not commit, push, create pull requests, deploy, or release directly on GitHub under Copilot or bot credentials.
- All commits and git actions must be attributed solely to the repository owner without automated co-authorship.

## Code Constraints
- Follow all constraints defined in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- Mobile API compliance: do not use Node.js desktop-only modules (`fs`, `path`, etc.) or browser `fetch`.
